operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) In conducting the study and in preparing his final recommendations to the President, the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations (hereinafter referred to as the "Special Representative") shall consider the views and recommendations of Members of the Congress, of the Public Advisory Committee on Trade Policy, and of other interested agencies of the United States Government concerning the future nature and direction of United States foreign trade policy.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Special Representative shall determine the most effective ways and means of obtaining such views and recommendations in order to render them as useful to the study as possible.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. Views of Members of Congress. For purposes of the study, the Special Representative shall review and consider the hearings on foreign trade held by various committees of the House of Representatives and the Senate during the 90th Congress, and shall seek the views and recommendations of the members of the committees of the House of Representatives and the Senate concerned with trade policy.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) For purposes of the study, there is hereby established a committee to be known as the Public Advisory Committee on Trade Policy, which shall furnish its views and recommendations to the Special Representative.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Committee shall be composed of not more than 35 members who shall be designated by the President from among, appropriately qualified citizens of the United States outside the United States Government, who shall be representative of various sectors of the economy of the United States, and who shall serve without compensation from the United States Government.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) The Committee shall meet upon the request of the Special Representative.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) For purposes of the study, the Departments of Agriculture, Commerce, Defense, Interior, Labor, State, and Treasury, and such other agencies as the Special Representative may from time to time call upon, shall furnish views and recommendations to him.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 4(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) In addition, the agencies referred to in subsection (a.) shall, at the request of the Special Representative, assist him in the preparation of the study by all appropriate means.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 4(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 5. Applicability of Executive Order No. 11007.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The provisions of sections 4, 6(a), 6 (b), 6(c), and 6(f) of Executive Order No. 11007 of February 26, 1962, which prescribes regulations for the formation and use of advisory committees, are hereby adapted and made applicable to the Public Advisory Committee on Trade Policy established by section 3 of this Order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Special Representative shall be responsible for assuring compliance with the provisions of Executive Order No. 11007 referred to in subsection (a) in relation to that Committee, and he is authorized to exercise the authority contained in section 6 (f) of that Order and to prescribe such additional regulations with respect to that Committee as he may deem necessary.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 6. Prior body and orders. The Public Advisory Committee for Trade Negotiations is hereby abolished, and Executive Order No. 11143 of March 2, 1964, and Executive Order No. 11159 of June 23, 1964, are hereby revoked.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 6
